replace.text: The commit made verify_quality an async function and replaced its synchronous Groq client call (model openai/gpt-oss-120b, max_tokens 5) with an awaited GroqProvider.generate call (max_tokens 60) in main.py, removing the client import and adding a GroqProvider instance

The fallback model mapping in models.py changed from llama-3.3-70b-versatile -> openai/gpt-oss-120b -> llama-3.1-8b-instant to openai/gpt-oss-120b -> openai/gpt-oss-20b. These are Groq-hosted models, the project has no OpenAI provider

add.text: A code comment in models.py says fallback applies only within Groq because Gemini's free tier is not rate-limit-fragile in the same way, and cross-provider fallback would need its own design
The _raw_call docstring in models.py says cost is computed from registry pricing in one place instead of inside each provider, so pricing logic is not duplicated per provider
In main.py the quality-judge call changed from max_tokens 5 to max_tokens 60
The judge max_tokens increase matches the token budget adjustments named in the commit message
In main.py select_model, call_model, verify_quality and build_model_metadata are now awaited
In main.py the response no longer includes candidates_considered
